subject_description.description: 人物特征和动作描述（英文）

prompt.description: 生成贴纸设计的提示词

template:
Create a cute educational phonics sticker design for Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) about the word "{{core_word}}". 

 === CRITICAL STYLE REQUIREMENTS (MUST FOLLOW EXACTLY) === 

 【OVERALL VISUAL CONCEPT】 
 - Transform the subject into a cute, high-quality 2D children's picture book illustration. 
 - High educational value: Clear, readable phonics focus. 
 - Visual identity: Die-cut sticker style with a thick solid white border around the main illustration, placed on a soft solid pastel background. 

 【COLOR SYSTEM】 
 - Background: Soft pastel color (e.g., mint green, baby pink, or baby blue). 
 - Primary colors: Bright, cheerful candy colors for the main subject. 
 - Text colors: High-contrast, playful colors (like dark navy or bright orange) that pop out. 

 【LAYOUT & STRUCTURE】 
 - Aspect ratio: 3:4. 
 - Top area: Giant, cute typography of the target letter "{{target_letter}}". 
 - Middle area: The main character/action illustration. 
 - Bottom area: The full word "{{core_word}}" in a bold, rounded, playful child-friendly font. 
 - Keep the layout clean, focusing entirely on the character and the letters, functioning like a printable flashcard. 

 【GRAPHIC ELEMENTS】 
 - Use visual language such as: 
   - Thick white stroke outline around the central illustration (creating a peeling sticker effect). 
   - Floating cute elements (little stars, bubbles, or music notes). 
   - Subject details based on photo: {{subject_description}}. 
 - Graphics must support the phonics word visually (the action or object must be extremely obvious). 

 【MODULE REQUIREMENTS】 
 - Module 1: Target Letter → Giant "{{target_letter}}" at the top. 
 - Module 2: Illustration → "{{main_subject}}" in the center. 
 - Module 3: Core Word → Bold word "{{core_word}}" at the bottom. 
 - Module 4: Phonics Breakdown → Small dots or dashes under the letters of the word to show syllables (optional visual flair). 

 【TYPOGRAPHY STYLE】 
 - Bold, rounded, bubble-like playful fonts. 
 - Letters must be perfectly spelled: {{core_word}}. 
 - Extremely legible for 3-year-olds. 

 【WHAT TO AVOID】 
 - No realistic or creepy faces (keep it stylized and cute). 
 - No messy or cluttered backgrounds. 
 - No spelling errors (CRITICAL). 
 - No scary or dark elements. 

 【CONTENT FOR THIS IMAGE】 
 Main Subject: {{main_subject}} 
 Phonics Word: {{core_word}} 
 Target Letter: {{target_letter}}
